Gramlot 0.2.12 renames the server object `GramlotServer`, gives Python and JS the same server functionality, tells development and deploy apart with `GRAMLOT_DEV`, and writes the browser protocol down with a conformance check.

## What changes

- `Host` is now `GramlotServer`: `FileHost` → `GramlotFileServer`, `HostCapacity` → `ServerCapacity`, type `HostOptions` → `GramlotServerOptions`. Files follow the classes: `js/src/adapters/` → `js/src/server/`, `gramlot-server.js`, `gramlot-file-server.js`; Python `gramlot_server.py`, `gramlot_file_server.py`. The JS export `@gramlot/gramlot/host` is now `@gramlot/gramlot/gramlot-server`; `@gramlot/gramlot/server` is unchanged.
- Same functionality in Python and JS: `close_all()` / `closeAll()` empties the page registry; the base `Page` is rejected as a page; a missing Source method raises `SourceNotFound`; the Source builder is named after the method; every JS error has its own `name`. In JS, `Page.registerSource('m')` replaces the free function `source(...)`; Python `@source` is unchanged.
- `GRAMLOT_DEV`: unset = deploy, `YES` = development, `DEBUG` = development with the readable runtime; any other value is an error. `GramlotFileServer` re-reads a page file at each new page open when `reload` is on (default from `GRAMLOT_DEV`); page modules are compiled from source. The runtime ships as `gramlot.js` and `gramlot.min.js`; `runtime_asset()` / `runtimeAsset()` select the file to serve (`runtimeAsset` returns a `URL`).
- GC-230 states the protocol every adapter exposes; `check_protocol(base_url, page_path)` (Python) and `checkProtocol(baseUrl, pagePath)` (JS), from `gramlot.server` and `@gramlot/gramlot/server`, check it over HTTP.
- GC-225 records the names: an attribute holding the server is `server`, or `gramlot_server` / `gramlotServer` where the framework already uses `server`.

## Upgrading from 0.2.11

- Rename the server classes and imports as listed above; there are no aliases.
- Adapters: call `close_all()` / `closeAll()` instead of clearing the page registry; serve the runtime through `runtime_asset()` / `runtimeAsset()`; run `check_protocol` / `checkProtocol` in their tests.
- JS pages: `Page.registerSource('m')` instead of `source(Page.prototype.m)`.
- gramlot-js-server, gramlot-py-server and gramlot-examples are released together with this version.
